title: Implement real-time event subscriptions for metadata and data changes
body:
AI chat creates objects but the Studio sidebar doesn't update until manual refresh. This implements end-to-end event streaming from backend operations to frontend UI. ## Architecture **Backend Event Publishing** - `MetadataManager` emits `metadata.{type}.{action}` events on create/update/delete - `ObjectQL Engine` emits `data.record.{action}` events on insert/update/delete - Both integrate via `IRealtimeService` dependency injection through plugin system - Graceful degradation: wrapped in try-catch, system works without realtime service **Client SDK** - New `RealtimeAPI` class exposes `subscribeMetadata()` and `subscribeData()` - Integrated as `client.events` property on `ObjectStackClient` - Subscription filters: type, packageId, recordId, eventTypes - Returns cleanup function for automatic unsubscribe **React Bindings** - `useMetadataSubscription()` / `useDataSubscription()` - stateful event hooks - `useMetadataSubscriptionCallback()` / `useDataSubscriptionCallback()` - callback variants for refetch triggers - `useRealtimeConnection()` - connection status indicator - `useAutoRefresh()` - automatic query invalidation on data changes **Studio UI** - Sidebar subscribes to 8 metadata types (object, view, app, agent, tool, flow, dashboard, report) - Triggers `loadMetadata()` refetch on any metadata event - No manual refresh required ## Usage ```typescript // React component with auto-refresh function ObjectList() { const { data, refetch } = useQuery('project_task', {}); // Refetch list when tasks are created/updated/deleted useDataSubscriptionCallback('project_task', refetch); return
{data.map(...)}
; } // Or with event state function TaskDetail({ taskId }) { const event = useDataSubscription('project_task', { recordId: taskId }); useEffect(() => { if (event?.type === 'data.record.updated') { console.log('Fields changed:', event.changes); } }, [event]); } ``` ## Event Schema - Metadata: `metadata.object.created`, `metadata.view.updated`, `metadata.agent.deleted`, etc. - Data: `data.record.created`, `data.record.updated`, `data.record.deleted`, `data.field.changed` All events defined in `packages/spec/src/api/events.zod.ts` with Zod schemas. ## Files Changed **New Files:** - `packages/spec/src/api/events.zod.ts` - Event type definitions - `packages/client/src/realtime-api.ts` - Client subscription API - `packages/client-react/src/realtime-hooks.tsx` - React hooks **Modified:** - `packages/spec/src/contracts/realtime-service.ts` - Extended IRealtimeService with subscription filters - `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` + `plugin.ts` - Event emission + DI wiring - `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` + `plugin.ts` - Event emission + DI wiring - `packages/client/src/index.ts` - Integrated RealtimeAPI - `packages/client-react/src/index.tsx` - Export hooks - `apps/studio/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx` - Subscribe to metadata events ## Future Work - WebSocket/SSE transport (currently in-memory adapter) - Connection retry logic - Event batching for high-frequency updates - Offline event queue
